message: Imported canonical English Task 2 fixture Context 'advisor1/structure' into profile 'task-2-proposal-authority'.

44249c8a-e84f-5c20-a9cd-a55457e98511.content: Complete the problem framing within the first two sentences so the reader reaches the proposal's central issue before any supporting background.

21371c6c-c74f-5791-8f9b-6d099306bfb5.content: Use the first sentence for the concrete problem and the second for its consequence; reserve later sentences for the proposed response.

f69ea80c-0d56-5fe8-9d24-8793eefa6643.content: Specify the user, context, and interaction to be explored in the primary HCI research question.

18ebdcbc-cf5a-5e6c-b2cd-b4cd07d7e59e.content: Provide one compact visual summary when proposing an unfamiliar interaction procedure.

5ab99a77-8836-50cf-8377-fdd23a208bc4.content: Mark the conditions that move an unfamiliar interaction procedure from one step to the next in its visual summary.

b9b7932b-85c1-5a14-80f7-0983dbf22380.content: Present the master’s research schedule as phased periods for exploration, design, prototyping, and user evaluation.

fc0a3a72-2da2-5843-be3a-a4ff2adf8fac.content: Link one reviewable deliverable to each phase of the master’s research.

2f7092a7-2625-5d27-bd76-a13ee5809cc2.content: Place the gap left by HCI-related research and the proposed design and empirical contributions in close proximity.

a1857f07-36cd-5a6c-946d-a308e712e9eb.content: Divide a two-page proposal with short descriptive subheadings so a reader can jump directly to the problem, proposed response, and next steps.

895b5ac9-1aa4-51d2-b89a-94e9fe5b869d.content: Give the problem and proposed response their own descriptive subheadings instead of relying only on paragraph transitions.

3005f4c5-e17b-531b-b9bf-c9d69411c71f.content: Give the next steps and requested support their own descriptive subheading so they remain easy to find on a return visit.

4913f63e-ceb9-587a-ade9-494fc8f28849.content: Place pilot observation or initial prototype results near sentences supporting feasibility claims.

8ecaec22-7c25-5a39-a85b-56db9c3b607e.content: This advisor has repeatedly seen readers decide what a proposal is about from its first two sentences before scanning the rest of the page.

a4536b84-40f2-57db-84e4-024c97c9fecb.content: When setup continues past the second sentence, readers who are skimming often retain the background topic but miss the exact problem being proposed.

2312cb6e-4f50-56f5-b725-ba5e45697a73.content: Reuse the same short subheadings in discussion so a reader can return to a section without searching through the whole page.

1d90043b-f010-5a14-9493-77f636c13975.content: Use visible subheadings as a completeness check: an empty or missing section makes an omitted part of the proposal immediately apparent.

b77fe6ec-676b-5bb9-9119-45aefea2aa27.content: This advisor has repeatedly seen readers scan section labels before deciding which paragraph to read closely.
